  • the present invention relates to a friction member such as a disc brake pad used for braking an automobile or the like, a friction material composition for a lining material used for the friction member, and a friction material.
  • a brake mounted on a car or the like can be roughly divided into two, mainly, a disc brake and a drum brake.
  • a disk brake is a device in which a disk rotor, which rotates integrally with a wheel during traveling, is sandwiched by brake pads, and a friction force generated at that time generates a braking force.
  • a drum brake is, for example, mounted with a brake lining (also referred to as a brake shoe) inside a drum installed inside a wheel, and exerts a braking force by pressure bonding it from the inside to the outside It is.
  • a friction material is provided on the brake pad of the disk brake and the brake lining of the drum brake, and the friction material rubs against the facing material such as the disk rotor and the drum, thereby converting the kinetic energy of the automobile or the like into thermal energy.
